description: This file implements push-to-talk voice recognition and hotkey handling for a macOS application. It includes classes for monitoring hotkey presses, managing speech recognition sessions, and integrating with system events and AVAudioEngine.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalkHotkey
classes.description: Handles system hotkeys for push-to-talk functionality, monitoring option key presses and triggering voice recognition activities.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalk
classes.description: Manages voice recognition sessions, speech recognition tasks, audio engine, and overlays for the push-to-talk feature.

methods.name: updateModifierState
methods.description: Updates internal state based on key code and modifier flags.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts a voice recognition session for push-to-talk.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends the current voice recognition session.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes partial or final transcription results.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the recognition session, handles cleanup and results.

methods.name: makeConfig
methods.description: Creates session configuration based on app state.
